channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: How to buy an NFT on Polygon with ETH on Ethereum
item.description: How to buy an NFT on Polygon with ETH held on Ethereum: bridge ETH to Polygon PoS, get POL for gas, approve WETH and confirm the NFT in your wallet.

item.title: Isolation Mode vs E-Mode: Match the Mode to Your Collateral
item.description: Isolation mode vs E-Mode in DeFi lending: isolation caps approved borrowing against one asset; E-Mode raises LTV for correlated collateral and debt.

item.title: Liquidity pool swap prices: how quotes change
item.description: Liquidity pools set token swap prices from reserves and pricing curves; trade size changes execution, so your average price can differ from the ending spot price.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2B in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance funds, part of a wider $2.7 billion freeze.

item.title: What Is Fraxtal Layer 2 for Beginners? A First-Trade Plan
item.description: What is Fraxtal Layer 2 for beginners? Start there for Frax apps and low fees, but hold the gas token first and plan for a slow native-bridge exit.

item.title: How to follow tokens after you click swap on SyncSwap
item.description: seo_title: What happens when I click swap on SyncSwap: token path

item.title: How to withdraw crypto from an exchange to an L2 wallet safely
item.description: Withdraw crypto from an exchange to a layer 2 wallet checklist: match the network and Chain ID, confirm the USDC version, fund L2 gas and test a small amount.

item.title: WBTC vs LBTC: what changes when bridging to Sui?
item.description: WBTC vs LBTC when bridging to Sui: WBTC is custodian-backed; LBTC represents Babylon-staked BTC, so the choice is reserve exposure versus staking exposure.

item.title: Why is my Polygon deposit pending after it succeeded?
item.description: Why does my exchange take so long to credit Polygon deposits? Learn how confirmation thresholds, reorg safety and contract transfers affect crediting.

item.title: US gets authority to seize $1.2B in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft, as efforts to trace and recover the funds continue.

item.title: Stake TRX for Energy When Daily Use Justifies the Lock
item.description: Staking TRX for Energy vs burning TRX pays when daily transactions justify a weeks-long lock; occasional users keep more flexibility by burning or renting.

item.title: How to clear a pending swap blocked by an earlier nonce
item.description: What is a nonce in an Ethereum transaction? The lowest pending nonce holds later transactions until it confirms or is replaced with a higher fee on that network.

item.title: How to Convert Bitcoin to WBTC for BTC Holders
item.description: How to convert bitcoin to WBTC: trade BTC for WBTC on an exchange, then withdraw it to your Ethereum wallet; direct minting is for approved merchants.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: MetaMask custom networks disappear after a clean delete
item.description: To remove a network from MetaMask, switch away from it, delete the custom entry from its three-dot menu and confirm it disappears from your list on desktop or mobile.

item.title: Which bridge providers does LI.FI use? Route examples
item.description: Which bridge providers does LI.FI use? LI.FI can route through Across, Stargate, Mayan, Circle CCTP or Relay; the provider varies by chain, tokens and route.

item.title: Is lifi bridge an aggregator? Identify what moves your funds
item.description: lifi bridge is an aggregator that routes transfers through other bridges and DEXs. See how to identify the provider that moves your tokens on each route.

item.title: Ticker or Contract? Verify Before a DEX Swap
item.description: How to verify a token contract before a DEX swap: match the network and full address to the issuer’s deployment record before selecting the asset.

item.title: Lock and mint vs burn and mint: choose by token support
item.description: Lock and mint vs burn and mint bridges: burn and mint preserves canonical supply when issuers control each chain; lock and mint broadens coverage but concentrates vault risk.
